f.title: Check for duplicates with specific search filters before entering a notification
f.statement: Before entering a notification, the user must make sure it has not previously been entered by its own organisation or by a third-level UFV, using specific search filters to detect duplication, such as initials, sex, date of birth, suspect medicine and reaction/event (MedDRA).

Para esto, debe utilizar filtros de búsqueda específicos (ver sección 4.4 “Información de la pantalla principal”) con la finalidad de detectar duplicidad, como pueden ser:  Iniciales  Sexo  Fecha de nacimiento  Medicamento sospechoso  Reacción/evento (MedDRA)

f.title: Treat a duplicate with new relevant information as follow-up to the first report
f.statement: If the notification has already been entered, the user must compare it and identify whether it contains additional relevant information that could modify the existing VigiFlow report (follow-up); if so, open the report corresponding to the first notification and enter the additional information.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

f.title: Collect missing mandatory fields so the report can be shared with the WHO database
f.statement: A report lacking mandatory fields can be saved but cannot be sent to the WHO global database; it is therefore a fundamental task of the reporter entering the report (or of the level to which it is delegated) to collect the missing information to increase information quality.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

f.title: Complete the mandatory report-information fields for a valid VigiFlow report
f.statement: VigiFlow requires mandatory fields, based on international pharmacovigilance requirements, for a report to be valid. In the Report information section these are: initial receipt date, report type, most recent receipt date (changed only on follow-up) and profession of the primary reporter (the "Informant" under NOM-220-SSA1-2016).

f.title: Notify clusters of two or more similar serious cases (same place, medicine and batch) within 48 hours
f.statement: Under NOM-220-SSA1-2016, two or more similar serious cases occurring in the same place, with the same medicine and the same batch must be notified immediately, without exceeding 48 hours from knowledge of the cases; such reports can be linked in VigiFlow's "Link reports" component.
f.applicability: Two or more similar serious cases in the same place, with the same medicine and the same batch.

f.title: Cite literature-report references in Vancouver style
f.statement: For literature reports (report type "Other"), the bibliographic reference(s) from which the report was obtained must be entered in the "Literature report" component, in Vancouver style.

rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'debe'/'deben' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user).
rows.quote_en: If you have a literature report and specified it in the Report type field with the option "Other", in this section you must enter the bibliographic reference(s) from which you obtained the report. Citations must be in Vancouver style.

f.title: Complete study information, including study type, for clinical-study reports
f.statement: For clinical-study cases (report type "clinical study report"), additional study information shall be entered in the study information section, choosing the study type: "Clinical trials", "Individual patient use" or "Others".

rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user). Study type: you shall choose between "Clinical trials", "Individual patient use" or "Others".

f.title: Enter the study name as in the COFEPRIS authorisation
f.statement: The study name must be entered preferably as established in the authorisation issued by the Health Authorisation Commission; otherwise, the title as reported.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Nombre del estudio: debe colocar el nombre del estudio preferentemente como está establecido en la autorización emitida por la Comisión de Autorización Sanitaria. En caso de no contar con este nombre, colocar el titulo tal como fue reportado.

rows.quote_en: Study name: you must enter the name of the study preferably as established in the authorisation issued by the Health Authorisation Commission. If this name is not available, enter the title as reported.

f.title: Code patient initials as paternal surname, maternal surname, given name(s)
f.statement: Patient initials shall be in capitals: first letter of the paternal surname, then of the maternal surname, then of the given name(s) (e.g. AGRA). For clinical-study reports the subject identification code replaces the initials; if unavailable, leave blank.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Deberá iniciar en mayúsculas colocando la primera letra del apellido paterno, seguida de la primera letra del apellido materno y por último colocar la primera letra del (los) nombre(s) Ejemplo: Raúl Alberto Aceves González, deberá codificarse de la siguiente manera  Primera letra del apellido paterno = A  Primera letra del apellido materno= G  Primera letra del (los) nombre(s)= RA Quedando de la siguiente manera: AGRA En el caso de que el reporte provenga de un estudio clínico, se sustituirán las iniciales por el código de identificación asignado al sujeto de estudio. En el caso de no tener este dato, dejar el campo en blanco.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to cover the AGRA example and the clinical-study code rule already in the statement. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Deberá'/'se sustituirán' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user).
rows.quote_en: It shall start in capitals, placing the first letter of the paternal surname, followed by the first letter of the maternal surname and finally the first letter of the given name(s). Example: Raúl Alberto Aceves González shall be coded as follows: first letter of the paternal surname = A; first letter of the maternal surname = G; first letter of the given name(s) = RA; giving: AGRA. Where the report comes from a clinical study, the initials shall be replaced by the identification code assigned to the study subject. If this information is not available, leave the field blank.

f.title: Complete the patient section with the neonate/infant data for parent-child reports
f.statement: If the Parent-Child report box was ticked, the Patient section fields shall be completed with the neonate's or infant's information (not fully applicable to a foetus), as shall the medical history data.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Si en la sección Información del reporte habilitó la casilla “Reporte Padres-hijo (Parent Child report)”, deberá llenar los campos de la sección “Paciente” con la información correspondiente al neonato o infante (no totalmente aplicables a un feto) del mismo modo corresponderán a los datos de la sección “historial clínico”.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user). Removed 'additional parent fields are then displayed' from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: If in the Report information section you ticked the box "Parent-Child report", you shall complete the fields of the "Patient" section with the information corresponding to the neonate or infant (not fully applicable to a foetus); likewise for the data of the "medical history" section.

f.title: Write the case narrative in the informant's words and mark each follow-up
f.statement: The case narrative shall use the informant's words and phrases, keeping the original narrative. When updating a report, a dividing line shall be added at the end of the previous text with the legend "Follow-up (number)" below it, followed by the additional information.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Caso narrativo: deberá colocar la narrativa del caso con las palabras y frases utilizadas por el informante (tal cual fue notificado por éste), manteniendo la narrativa original. En caso de actualizar un reporte (Ver punto 4.7 Ingreso de información adicional de un reporte (SEGUIMIENTO)) se deberá agregar una línea divisoria al final del texto previo del campo “Caso narrativo” y debajo de esta colocar la leyenda “Seguimiento (Numero de seguimiento)” y posteriormente escribir la información adicional.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá'/'se deberá' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user).
rows.quote_en: Case narrative: you shall enter the case narrative with the words and phrases used by the informant (as notified by them), keeping the original narrative. When updating a report (see 4.7 Entering additional information on a report (FOLLOW-UP)), a dividing line shall be added at the end of the previous text of the "Case narrative" field and below it the legend "Follow-up (follow-up number)", followed by the additional information.

f.title: Record NOM-220 severity, information grade and causality references in reporter comments
f.statement: Because VigiFlow has no fields for the Mexican severity and information-quality classifications, UFVs, CEFV, CIFV and CICFV are requested to use the reporter-comments field for: severity of non-serious manifestations (mild, moderate, severe; NOM-220 numeral 8.1.6); grade of information (0 to 3; numeral 8.1.4); and the bibliographic references (Vancouver style) supporting the Naranjo causality classification, which must be provided.
f.clause: 4.5.5 Caso narrativo e información adicional (Comentarios del notificador)

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote:
se solicita que las UFV, los CEFV, CIFV y los CICFV, utilicen este campo libre para colocar la siguiente información:  Severidad de las manifestaciones (con base a lo establecido en el numeral 8.1.6 de la NOM-220-SSA1-2016): leve, moderado y severo. Solo para manifestaciones clasificadas como NO GRAVES.  Grado de información (con base a lo establecido en el numeral 8.1.4 de la NOM-220-SSA1-
2016) del caso: grado 0 a 3.  Referencias Bibliográficas: se ha establecido para UFV, CEFV, CICFV y CIFV como metodología para la evaluación de causalidad el algoritmo de Naranjo, por ello deben proporcionarse las referencias bibliográficas utilizadas que respalden la clasificación causal. Las citas deben colocarse en Estilo Vancouver.
rows.location: 4.5.5 Caso narrativo e información adicional (Comentarios del notificador)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'se solicita' (request) with 'deben proporcionarse'; Mandatory is a judgement; actors named; line break inside 'NOM-220-SSA1-2016'.
rows.quote_en: the UFV, CEFV, CIFV and CICFV are requested to use this free field to enter the following information: Severity of the manifestations (according to numeral 8.1.6 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016): mild, moderate and severe. Only for manifestations classified as NON-SERIOUS. Grade of information (according to numeral 8.1.4 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016) of the case: grade 0 to 3. Bibliographic references: the Naranjo algorithm has been established for UFV, CEFV, CICFV and CIFV as the causality-assessment methodology, so the bibliographic references used that support the causal classification must be provided. Citations must be in Vancouver style.

f.title: Enter relevant medical history and discontinued previous treatment
f.statement: Relevant information (helping causality assessment) on the patient's medical history and relevant conditions and on previous medical treatment (medicines discontinued before the SRAM; previous experience with similar medicines) must be entered.
f.clause: 4.5.6 Historia clínica y tratamiento médico previo relevante

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: En esta sección debe ingresar información relevante (que ayude a la evaluación causal) de la historia clínica y condiciones relevantes (enfermedades, condiciones como embarazo, cirugías, trauma psicológico, factores de riesgo, entre otros) del paciente y el tratamiento médico previo (medicamentos relevantes administrados previamente al paciente y que se han suspendido previo a la ocurrencia de las SRAM; puede incluirse también la experiencia previa con medicamentos similares).
rows.location: 4.5.6 Historia clínica y tratamiento médico previo relevante
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'debe' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user).
rows.quote_en: In this section you must enter relevant information (that helps the causality assessment) on the patient's medical history and relevant conditions (illnesses, conditions such as pregnancy, surgery, psychological trauma, risk factors, among others) and previous medical treatment (relevant medicines previously administered to the patient and discontinued before the SRAM occurred; previous experience with similar medicines may also be included).

f.title: Second level converts free-text medical history into MedDRA terms
f.statement: It is the task of the second level of VigiFlow operation (or the first level where applicable) to review free-text medical history information and convert it into a standardised MedDRA term.
f.clause: 4.5.6 Historia clínica y tratamiento médico previo relevante

rows.actor: Second-level centres (or the CNFV where applicable)
rows.quote: Es labor del segundo nivel de operación de VigiFlow (o del primer nivel cuando aplique), revisar esta información en texto libre y pasarla a un término estandarizado en MedDRA.
rows.location: 4.5.6 Historia clínica y tratamiento médico previo relevante
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. No modal verb ('Es labor del'); Mandatory is a judgement; first level = CNFV inferred. Removed the free-text entry sentence from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: It is the task of the second level of VigiFlow operation (or of the first level where applicable) to review this free-text information and convert it into a standardised MedDRA term.

f.title: Record each SRAM, RAM, EA, ESAVI or other safety problem in the Reaction section
f.statement: The SRAM, RAM, EA, ESAVI or any other safety problem related to the use of medicines and vaccines shall be recorded in the Reaction section.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: En esta sección deberá registrarse la(s) SRAM, RAM, EA, ESAVI o cualquier otro problema de seguridad relacionado con el uso de medicamentos y vacunas.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Impersonal 'deberá registrarse'; actor inferred. Removed the MedDRA/reported-term clause from statement (covered by row 0033, not in this quote).
rows.quote_en: In this section the SRAM, RAM, EA, ESAVI or any other safety problem related to the use of medicines and vaccines shall be recorded.

f.title: Keep both the reported reaction term and the MedDRA term
f.statement: Users are asked to keep both what was originally reported and the corresponding MedDRA term so that, if necessary, the relationship between the primary reporter's term and the sender's term can be analysed.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Se solicita dejar ambas opciones, tanto lo que se informó originalmente como el término MedDRA que le corresponde, de esta manera y si es necesario, se podrá analizar la relación entre el término tal como fue reportado por el notificador primario / original y el término ingresado por el emisor.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Se solicita' read as Recommended (judgement call); actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: You are asked to keep both options, both what was originally reported and the corresponding MedDRA term; in this way and if necessary, the relationship between the term as reported by the primary/original reporter and the term entered by the sender can be analysed.

f.title: Apply the seriousness classification to each reaction
f.statement: "Serious" is marked YES when the reaction meets the established seriousness criteria; the seriousness classification must be applied to each reaction, so a case may contain both serious and non-serious reactions.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Grave Elegir la casilla “SI” cuando la reacción cumpla con los criterios de gravedad/seriedad establecidos. En caso de haber habilitado alguna opción y requiere eliminarla, puede limpiar las casillas oprimiendo la opción “Vaciar campos”. Para cada reacción debe aplicarse la clasificación de gravedad, por lo que podría haber en un caso reacciones graves y otras no graves.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Impersonal 'debe aplicarse' = Mandatory; actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: Serious: choose "YES" when the reaction meets the established seriousness criteria. If you have selected an option and need to remove it, you can clear the boxes with the "Clear fields" option. The seriousness classification must be applied to each reaction, so a case may have serious reactions and others that are not serious.

f.title: Assign each medicine a role: suspect, concomitant, interacting or not administered
f.statement: The suspect medicine must be identified and the others recorded as concomitant (unless more than one suspect is justified). If the reaction is due to an interaction between two or more medicines, those medicines must be recorded as interacting (the system requires at least two).

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Debe considerar cuál es el medicamento sospechoso y los demás corresponderán a medicamentos concomitantes (salvo en algunas excepciones en donde se justifique ingresar más de un medicamento sospechoso). Si la SRAM, EA, RAM, ESAVI es debida a la interacción entre dos o más medicamentos, debe dejar estos medicamentos como interactuantes, ya que el sistema le solicitará al menos dos medicamentos para una interacción.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'debe' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user). Statement no longer lists 'drug not administered' (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: You must consider which is the suspect medicine and the others will be concomitant medicines (except in some exceptions where entering more than one suspect medicine is justified). If the SRAM, EA, RAM, ESAVI is due to the interaction between two or more medicines, you must record these medicines as interacting, since the system will require at least two medicines for an interaction.

f.title: Code the medicine in WHODrug in priority order: distinctive name, generic name, active ingredient
f.statement: When entering a medicine name, the available name information shall be entered in priority order, first by distinctive name, checking that the active ingredient(s) match exactly, because a Mexican brand name may exist in another country with different actives.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Al ingresar el nombre de un medicamento deberá considerar la información con la que se cuenta acerca del nombre e introducirlo de acuerdo al siguiente orden de prioridad: 1. Denominación distintiva: Ingresar el nombre del medicamento de acuerdo con la denominación distintiva y corroborar que el(los) ingrediente(s) activo(s) corresponden exactamente al medicamento, esto debido a que el nombre comercial de un medicamento en México puede ser el mismo en otro país, pero los principios activos pudieran ser diferentes.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user). Statement trimmed to priority 1 (generic name and active ingredient priorities are not in the quote).
rows.quote_en: When entering the name of a medicine you shall consider the information available on the name and enter it in the following order of priority: 1. Distinctive name: enter the name of the medicine according to the distinctive name and check that the active ingredient(s) correspond exactly to the medicine, because the brand name of a medicine in Mexico may be the same in another country but the active ingredients could be different.

f.title: Use the reported-name field when the medicine is not in WHODrug
f.statement: If the medicine is not found in the catalogue, it must be entered in the field "medicine name as reported by the initial/original reporter".

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: En caso de no encontrar en el catálogo el (los) medicamento(s) o fármaco(s) deseados, debe colocarlo en el campo “nombre del medicamento tal como fue reportado por el notificador inicial / original”.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'debe' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user). Removed the clause on structured fields from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: If the desired medicine(s) or drug(s) are not found in the catalogue, you must enter it in the field "medicine name as reported by the initial/original reporter".

f.title: Enter the labelled strength, including every active of a combination
f.statement: The strength stated on the medicine label must be entered (e.g. 50 mg); for combination medicines, the strength of all actives must be added in the order displayed in WHODrug.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)
rows.quote: Debe ingresar la concentración establecida en el marbete del medicamento. n Ejemplo: 50 mg. Para medicamentos combinados (que cuentan con más de un principio activo) debe agregar la concentración de todos los activos tal cual el orden como se despliegan en el catálogo de WHODRUG.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Debe' = Mandatory; actor inferred from context (second-person instruction to the VigiFlow user); stray 'n' layout artefact in the quote.
rows.quote_en: You must enter the strength established on the medicine label. Example: 50 mg. For combination medicines (with more than one active ingredient) you must add the strength of all actives in the order in which they are displayed in the WHODrug catalogue.

rows.quote_en: This field is in free-text format; however, you must consider the following pharmaceutical forms established in the Pharmacopoeia of the United Mexican States:

rows.quote_en: Batch number: you must add the batch number of the medicine reported. f.title: Record the vaccine dose number for ESAVI

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance network members entering reports in VigiFlow (UFV, CEFV, CICFV, CIFV, CENSIA/DGE)

rows.quote_en: If information on the indication for which the medicine was prescribed is not available, you shall search the catalogue for the option "drug use for unknown indication".

f.title: Enter "No adverse reaction" when a medicine-use problem caused no signs or symptoms
